card.title: Permissions and privileges
card.description: Effective permissions: those of the roles, plus granted and minus denied ones.
card.adminNote: Admins hold every permission of the identity center: privileges apply only in external systems

fields.reasonPlaceholder: E.g. covering for a colleague on vacation

add.title: Add privilege
add.description: Grants a permission the roles lack or removes one they have. An existing privilege for that permission is replaced.

remove.confirmDescription: The user goes back to what their roles say for this permission.

errors.forbidden: You cannot manage a permission you do not hold, nor your own privileges
errors.adminTarget: Admins hold every permission of the identity center: they cannot receive privileges here
errors.generic: The privilege could not be saved
